author: MattiChine00
quote:
- A complete disaster ****.
- Full of woke propaganda. (You can’t kill/harm protesters or steal your neighbor car.)
- You can’t even hookup **** like in the past titles. (Which is absurd.)
- No physical disk in 2026. (And with that, I’ve already said everything…)
- Constant drops of FPS. (Locked 30FPS on Consoles in the 2026 is simply unacceptable.)
- The story is a huge pain in the ass, boring & basically a cuckold simulator. (Lucia’s character is atrocious, annoying & Jason have no balls/personality, he’s only a slave for her with basically no dignity, masculinity or whatsoever.)
- Not re-playable story missions. (In a GTA game… In 2026… Yeah…)
- Full of alarming, bad bugs & completely broken physic. (Clearly they even didn’t do a playtest.)
On the summary: a complete garbage mess ****. And if it wasn’t for the name “GTA” then this game would have been already fully destroyed at launch by critics and bad reviews…
13 years + 2 billions of dollars budget for then developing this absolute disaster, congrats Rockstar Games! 
0/10.
